title: The Puppet Show
text: A puppet theatre on a cart, curtains open, no puppeteer in sight, playing to an audience of silent crows. The little wooden figures fight and bleed red paint. They look like you, every one of you, down to the scars.

options.label: Watch the show to its end.

outcomes.text: It ends happily, against all odds. It is a comfort, and you do not ask why.
It ends as such shows do, with every little wooden you lying still, and the crows applauding.

options.label: The sharpest eye looks for the strings.

outcomes.text: There are none, and then there are, and they lead off into the trees to something hidden.
The puppets scream in your voices as they burn.
